about: Thresholds for scoring a proposal's cards, one entry per question class, in lane-check's policy shape. act_at for obvious_now is Guillaume's rule of 2026-10-09 (act when his word and the engine agree at 0.8 or above). needs_owner is read against owner_at: at or above it the card goes to 'needs you' whatever obvious_now says (Decision Gate D1). Nothing here is calibrated from rulings yet; the first rulings are Guillaume's answers on the first scored page.
set_by: Guillaume, spoken 2026-10-09 (session miadi-jev-fork1): act at high confidence with the engine, come back otherwise; applied to proposals by Mia 2026-10-10

obvious_now.does_not_authorize: publishing, naming, deleting, opening issues or anything reaching people; do_now only lets the agent do the reversible step and report it

needs_owner.does_not_authorize: settling for him; a true answer sends the card to him with the evidence

implied_by_request.does_not_authorize: anything; it is read beside obvious_now

reversible.does_not_authorize: anything; it is read beside obvious_now

evidence_sufficient.does_not_authorize: anything; a false answer says the page must measure more before the step runs

recommendation_sound.does_not_authorize: anything; it is read beside obvious_now
